{Root : Type u_1} → {F : Type u_2} → [inst : Field F] → {ι : Type u_3} → {r : ℕ} → Submodule F (ι → F) → Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r → (ι → F) → Prop := fun {Root} {F} [Field F] {ι} {r} C A f => f ∈ C ∧ ∀ (i : Fin r), (A.weights i) f = A.targets i

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} {C : Submodule F (ι → F)} {A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r} {f : ι → F}, Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim.Satisfies C A f → Minidregg.Selvage.decider C A f

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq F] {dom : ι ↪ F} {d : ℕ} {rt : Root} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)} {f : ι → F}, Minidregg.Selvage.decider (Minidregg.Selvage.reedSolomonCode dom d) (Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim.ofConstraints rt cs) f ↔ f ∈ Minidregg.Selvage.constrainedRS dom d cs

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} (foldRoot : Root → F → Root → Root) (C : Submodule F (ι → F)) (A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r) (links : List (Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r × F)) (f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.decider C (Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot A links) f ↔ f ∈ C ∧ ∀ (i : Fin r), (A.weights i) f = (Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot A links).targets i

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} {C : Submodule F (ι → F)} {A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r} {f : ι → F}, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim.Satisfies C A f → ¬Minidregg.Selvage.decider C A f

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} (C : Submodule F (ι → F)) (A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r) (f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.decider C A f ↔ Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim.Satisfies C A f

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} (foldRoot : Root → F → Root → Root) (A B : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r) (γ : F) (links : List (Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r × F)), Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot A ((B, γ) :: links) = Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot (Minidregg.Selvage.foldClaims foldRoot A B γ) links

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} (foldRoot : Root → F → Root → Root) (A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r), Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot A [] = A

∀ {Root : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] {ι : Type u_3} {r : ℕ} (foldRoot : Root → F → Root → Root) (A : Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r) (links : List (Minidregg.Selvage.AccClaim Root F ι r × F)), (Minidregg.Selvage.foldChain foldRoot A links).weights = A.weights
